args.subject: Refund Confirmation - Ticket C-6709
args.body:
Dear Tailspin Ltd,

We have reviewed your billing record for last month and confirmed that you were billed at an incorrect plan tier. Your correct plan tier is SILVER.

We have issued a refund of $310 to cover the tier overbilling. The refund should appear on your statement within 3-5 business days.

We apologize for the inconvenience. If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,
Support Team
